programme.title: South Park: Succuban
programme.desc: Cartman besöker optikern, en man som gör sig lustig över Cartmans viktproblem genom att kalla honom 'Piggy'.

programme.title: South Park: Anabola aber
programme.desc: Det är dags för Special Olympics i South Park. Cartman måste övertyga kvalificeringskommittén om att han är handikappad så att han kan slå Jimmy i det kommande evenemanget.

programme.title: South Park: Tittarkampen
programme.desc: Pojkarna blir indragna i ett krig om tittarsiffror när programmet 'Super School News' riskerar att läggas ned, och de sänker sig till vilken nivå som helst för att locka till sig tittare.

programme.title: South Park: Crackbabyförbundet
programme.desc: När Kyle upptäcker att Cartman arbetar frivilligt med crackbebisar på sjukhuset blir han misstänksam. Och vad har Slash från Guns N' Roses med detta att göra?

programme.title: South Park: Pandemin
programme.desc: South Park börjar likna Cloverfield när Randy visar dem skakiga inspelningar han gjort med sin videokamera av en stor mystisk varelse som härjar jorden runt.

programme.title: South Park: Black Friday
programme.desc: Pojkarna gör sig redo att slåss mot andra kunder på julhandelns första dag.

programme.title: South Park: Valhoror
programme.desc: Stan försöker att stoppa japanerna från att döda alla valar och delfiner i världen.

programme.title: South Park: Lägg ifrån dig den
programme.desc: Nordkorea ställer in siktet på South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Tweek mot Craig
programme.desc: Pojkarna övertygar två av sina motvilliga klasskamraten, Tweek och Craig, att vara med i ett slagsmål på skolgården.

programme.title: South Park: Britneys nya look
programme.desc: Mediecirkusen anländer till South Park när Britney gömmer sig i den avlägsna bergsstaden. Pojkarna försöker hjälpa den deprimerade popstjärnan.

programme.title: South Park: Dö, hippie, dö
programme.desc: Cartman arresteras för att fängsla hippies, men när South Park översvämmas av hippies vänder sig staden till honom och han oortodoxa metoder för att bli av med hippiesarna.

programme.title: South Park: Den ståndaktiga dagen
programme.desc: Jimmy oroar sig för att hans konstanta erektion kommer att hindra honom från att ställa upp i talangjakten och vinna priset på 1000 dollar.

programme.title: South Park: Back to the Cold War
programme.desc: Mycket hänger på Butters förmåga att krossa motståndet i det viktiga dressyrmästerskapet.

programme.title: South Park: Svältande Marvin
programme.desc: Under en reklampaus med Terrance och Philip bestämmer sig pojkarna för att adoptera ett etiopiskt barn eftersom man får en gratis digital sportklocka på köpet.

programme.title: South Park: En dumskalle och en dansk
programme.desc: Praktsvinet vill hoppa av presidentvalet.

programme.title: iCarly: iPity the Nevel
programme.desc: När en video där Nevel skriker åt en liten flicka börjar spridas på nätet, blir Nevel hatad av alla. Efter att ha firat Nevels fall hjälper iCarlygänget Nevel att återfå sin ära, eftersom han har bett dem om hjälp.

programme.title: iCarly: iHire an Idiot
programme.desc: Carly och Sam anställer en snygg kille för att hjälpa till i showen.

programme.title: iCarly: OMG
programme.desc: Gänget spenderar natten på Ridgeway med att göra klart sina skolprojekt under skolans årliga inlåsningstradition. Carly och Freddie börjar misstänka att Sam kanske är kär i deras nya kompis Brad.

programme.title: iCarly: iParty With Victorious
programme.desc: Carly misstänker att hennes nya pojkvän, Steven, är otrogen mot henne med Tori Vega, så gänget planerar en tripp till Los Angeles för att ta honom på bar gärning på Andres party hemma i Kenan Thompsons hus.

programme.title: iCarly: iDejt - Sam och Freddie
programme.desc: Carly går in för att medla i ett gräl mellan Sam och Freddie. Snart kommer Freddie och Sam till Carly för att få hjälp varenda gång de grälar. När hon nu blivit involverad, hur ska Carly kunna dra sig ur situationen?

programme.title: iCarly: iNTE uthärdligt
programme.desc: Freddies mamma upptäcker Sams och Freddies relation efter att Gibby, nu föremål för Sams hämnd, gjort upp planer för att splittra dem. Kommer Carly att kämpa för Sam och Freddie, eller hjälpa Gibby att få dem att göra slut?

programme.title: iCarly: Jag älskar dej
programme.desc: Carly säger åt Sam och Freddie att prova varandras favorithobbies. Under tiden stöter Spencer på sin gamla barnvakt och bjuder ut henne på middag. Efter att de återfallit i sina gamla roller, kommer de att kunna fortsätta vara tillsammans?

programme.title: iCarly: iQ
programme.desc: Carly försöker imponera på sin nya pojkvän genom att verka smartare än hon är. Under tiden försöker gänget hitta ett nytt ställe där T-Bo kan bo, efter det att han blivit utsparkad från Groovy Smoothie.

programme.title: iCarly: iMöter rikets första dam
programme.desc: En högt uppsatt statlig myndighet börjar utreda iCarly-gänget efter att de hackat sig in i ett säkerhetsnätverk, för att kunna ge Carlys pappa ett födelsedagskalas online. Gästartist - Michelle Obama.

programme.title: iCarly: iTån och Fat Cakes
programme.desc: Gänget, minus Carly, tar med Sam till den kanadensiska Fat Cake-fabriken, och upptäcker sedan att Sam inte får komma tillbaka till USA. Under tiden får Carly bekymmer i badkaret medan hon gör sig klar inför sin dejt.

programme.title: iCarly: iSynproblem
programme.desc: Efter att ha blivit "dissad" i en intervju om iCarly, försöker Freddie visa sin kreativa sida genom att webb-sända iCarly i 3D. Spencer anställer en assistent som han inte har råd att betala.

programme.title: iCarly: iTabbar 2: Electric Tabbaloo
programme.desc: Christopher Cane, skådespelaren som spelar Rex i Victorious, återvänder för att djup-intervjua stjärnorna i iCarly, och visa deras superroliga tabbar och bortklippta scener. Gästartist: Rex från Victorious.

programme.title: iCarly: iFortfarande galen
programme.desc: Efter att ha fått veta att Nora Dershlit kan komma att släppas ut ur fängelset, gör iCarly- ungdomarna vad de kan för att se till att deras gamla kidnappare ska förbli bakom galler. Under tiden upptäcker Freddies mamma den verklige T-Bo.

programme.title: Teen Mom OG
programme.desc: Maci, Catelynn och Amber träffar Nessa för att se ett gäng roliga och rörande klipp som inte har visats under säsongens Teen Mom OG.

programme.title: Teen Mom OG
programme.desc: På familjesemestern i Key West grälar Farrah och Debras fästman David om bristen på respekt mellan dem, Catelynn och Tyler lägger ett vinnande bud på sitt drömhus, och Maci försöker konfrontera Ryan.

programme.title: Teen Mom OG
programme.desc: I första delen av finalspecialen ryter Amber ifrån om sitt komplicerade förhållande med Matt, och Maci ställs inför kalla fakta om Ryans droganvändande.

programme.title: Teen Mom OG
programme.desc: Catelynn, Maci och Amber blir seriösa och känslosamma när de besvarar fansens frågor om serien och livet utanför tv-rutan.

programme.title: Teen Mom OG
programme.desc: I del 2 av Teen Mom OG Finale Special förklarar Farrah varför hon ogillar sin ammas fästman och Catelynn berättar hur hon och Tyler hanterade Butchs återfall.

programme.title: Teen Mom OG: Icing on a Cake of Lies
programme.desc: Ambers tålamod med Ryans fru tar slut, Maci vill att Ryan fullföljer sin rehab för att få träffa Bentley, Catelynn oroar sig för Butchs villkorliga frigivning, Farrah firar sin födelsedag i New York, och Amber blåser av förlovningen.

programme.title: Teen Mom OG: Too Shady
programme.desc: Farrah åker till Las Vegas med kompisarna men Simon dyker upp, Catelynn och Tyler skyndar sig för att bli klara med sin klädkollektion för barn, Maci låter Bentley träffa Ryan på fars dag, och Amber sparkar ut Matt.

programme.title: Teen Mom OG: System Overload
programme.desc: Maci vill drogtesta Ryan innan han får träffa Bentley, Farrah åker på affärsresa utomlands och lämnar Sophia hos Michael, Catelynn och Tyler får problem med sin klädkollektion, och Amber och Matt försöker rädda sitt förhållande.

programme.title: Starting Up Love
programme.desc: When workaholic Jillian gets a note that her long-lost, wealthy uncle has passed away, she finds he’s left her his beautiful mountainside cabin – and a family she never knew existed! Jillian’s plan is to sell it as soon as possible and move on, but when she meets handsome caretaker Liam, he makes her an offer she can’t refuse.

programme.title: Meet Dave
programme.desc: En besetning av miniatyraliens styr et romskip som har menneskelig form. Mens de prøver å redde planeten sin, møter aliens et nytt problem, da skipet blir forelsket i en jordisk kvinne.

programme.title: The Baby Proposal
programme.desc: Layla Bennett has it all figured out, her own place, a thriving career and a loving fiancé. She co-hosts morning show Wake Up Chicago! Alongside her charming but sometimes irritating colleague Derek Dray. They have different working styles. She likes to be spontaneous and improvise on air, while he’s more of a stick to the script guy. When they’re given the bombshell of caring for a baby together, it’s their worst nightmare…But as they juggle night feeds and nap times with their hectic lives, they can’t deny the growing chemistry. Is this unexpected arrival all they needed to realise they were meant to be?

programme.title: A Slice of Romance
programme.desc: When unlucky in love PR Executive Mikayla meets coffee shop owner and aspiring pastry chef Austin, the pair strike a deal: she'll taste his desserts if he gives her dating advice. Little did they know sparks would fly between them.

programme.title: Reaching for the Moon
programme.desc: När den amerikanska poeten Elizabeth Bishop drabbas av skrivkramp i början av 1950-talet bestämmer hon sig för att resa till Brasilien. Där träffar Elizabeth arkitekten Lota de Macedo Soares och de blir snart attraherade av varandra.

programme.title: Red Joan
programme.desc: En dag besöks den pensionerade bibliotekarien Joan Stanley av brittiska säkerhetstjänsten som arresterar henne för spioneri. Alla omkring Joan chockas av att denna stillsamma dam misstänks för att vara en av de mest inflytelserika spionerna i historien.

programme.title: Jimmy P.
programme.desc: En orolig indianveteran bildar en exceptionell vänskap med en fransk psykoanalytiker när de försöker hitta botemedel mot deras lidande.

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: Chris är en ung, vacker men pank tennistränare som blir involverad i en rik familj genom att träna en av familjemedlemmarna. Kärleksaffärer med två kvinnor samtidigt tvingar honom att begå ett allvarligt brott.

programme.title: Bulletproof Monk
programme.desc: The Monk är en zen-cool martial arts-mästare vars uppgift har varit att beskydda en mäktig antik skrift, en mystisk artefakt som bär nyckeln till obegränsad makt. Nu har The Monk inlett sitt sökande efter skriftens näste väktare, och uppdraget för honom till USA.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Den italienska westernstjärnan Bud Spencer (hans riktiga namn är Carlo Pedersoli) spelar en godhjärtad men järnnävad bananodlare som bor i en liten djungelby.

programme.title: Udda eller jämt
programme.desc: Polisen har misslyckats med att krossa ligan som svarar för den illegala spelverksamheten i Florida. Marinofficeren Johnny Firpo tar över uppdraget och räknar med hjälp av ex-spelaren Charlie Firpo.

programme.title: Survivor
programme.desc: Survivor är en thriller om en av det amerikanska utrikesdepartementets säkerhetsexperter som får en tjänst vid USA:s ambassad i London. Hennes jobb är att stoppa terrorister från att ta sig in i USA och det placerar henne direkt i skottlinjen.

programme.title: Team Albert
programme.desc: "Gör vad du har lust till." Gymnasieeleven Albert tar det välmenande rådet bokstavligt. Att gå på universitetet efter gymnasiet och sedan få ett kontorsjobb är helt enkelt inte hur han föreställer sig sin framtid.

programme.title: Ensamma i rymden
programme.desc: I en inte allt för avlägsen framtid färdas det gigantiska rymdskeppet Svea med endast två passagerare - 12-åriga Gladys och hennes lillebror Keaton. Barnen har flytt från ett trasigt jordklot och är på väg mot planeten Vial, men de tycks aldrig komma fram.

programme.title: Anti
programme.desc: Året är 1991. Simon och hans bästa kompis Frede lever i en förortsbubbla utanför Köpenhamn utan andra framtidsdrömmar än nästa joint som ska rullas. Simon har alltid älskat att rita, men har aldrig trott att hans talang skulle kunna användas till något.

programme.title: Amatörer
programme.desc: Lafors. Ett litet samhälle som en gång i tiden hade mycket att erbjuda. Nu en småstad bland många andra, med övergivna industrier och desperat behov av nystart. Problemet verkar vara på väg att lösa sig när en tysk lågpriskedja överväger att öppna en butik i samhället.

programme.title: Gourmet Club
programme.desc: Filmen följer en doktor som tillhör en grupp på fem överklassherrar som träffas varje månad i ett slutet rum på en lyxkrog. En av dem tar med sig en hemlig ingrediens som kocken tillagar och som de övriga sedan ska försöka identifiera.

programme.title: Saints Of War
programme.desc: Jersey, 1942. Hitler stärker sitt grepp om Västeuropa och Kanalöarna blir ockuperade.

programme.title: Mothers and Daughters
programme.desc: Från ett höghus på Manhattan kikar den hippa och lyckliga singeltjejen Rigby Gray in i sina grannars lägenheter och liv. Hon känner sig trygg bakom sitt långa kameraobjektiv och är helt omedveten om att hennes liv snart kommer att förändras för all framtid.

programme.title: The Shack
programme.desc: Filmen bygger på den bästsäljande romanen Ödehuset och vi följer en pappas upplyftande andliga resa. Mack Phillips drabbas av en familjetragedi och sjunker ner i en djup depression som får honom att ifrågasätta sina allra innersta övertygelser...

programme.title: Mortdecai
programme.desc: Charlie Mortdecai är en charmerande konstkännare och livsnjutare med dyra vanor. Han går med på att hjälpa den brittiska underrättelsetjänsten MI5 med att hitta en stulen tavla som sägs gömma på koden till en svindlande summa gömda nazimiljoner...

programme.title: The Way Way Back
programme.desc: 14-årige Duncan tvingas tillbringa sommarlovet med sin mamma Pam, hennes påfrestande pojkvän Trent och hansdotter Steph. Det är en tuff utmaning för Duncan att försöka passa in i den nya familjekonstellationen.

programme.title: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
programme.desc: Välkomna till en katolsk flickskola i hjärtat av Chicago, staden som är hem för USA:s populäraste dansshow: Dance TV! Utbytesstudenten Janey Glenn är ett nervvrak när hon blir presenterad för sina fnittrande klasskompisar av stränga syster Katherine.

programme.title: Love, Weddings & Other Disasters
programme.desc: En romantisk komedi berättad genom parallella historier om människor som jobbar med bröllop för att skapa den perfekta dagen för ett par som älskar varandra.

programme.title: Death At A Funeral
programme.desc: En komisk vriden historia om en dysfunktionell familj som samlas för att sörja sin patriarks bortgång. Daniels far har just avlidit och det enda han vill är att genomföra begravningen som planerat, vilket inte är det lättaste med en galen familj på halsen.

programme.title: Step Up Revolution
programme.desc: Rikemansdottern Emily är nyinflyttad till Miami när hon träffar den sexiga dansaren Sean. Han står i spetsen för flash mob-gänget, THE MOB, som är i full färd med att förvandla stadens gator till den vildaste gatufesten någonsin!

programme.title: My Super Ex
programme.desc: Denna sanslösa komedi bevisar att det kan vara rent av livsfarligt att göra slut. Matt tror sig ha funnit den rätta när han träffar Jenny som är både sexig och smart...

programme.title: Beautiful Creatures
programme.desc: 17-årige Ethan drömmer sig långt bort från sin lilla hemby – tills han möter nyinflyttade Lena.

programme.title: En kvinnas öde
programme.desc: I slutet av 1500-talet, som älskarinnor till Venedigs betydelsefulla män, levde kvinnor en kunglig livsstil och uppmuntrades att läsa och studera vid en tidpunkt då sådan utbildning var förbjuden för de flesta kvinnor.

programme.title: Elfette Räddar Julen
programme.desc: När tomten kidnappas av New York-maffian strax före jul, kommer Elfette, en speciell nisse, till undsättning. Hon och hennes vän Sparkle ska stoppa skurkarna, hitta tomten och rädda julen.

programme.title: Sänder jul
programme.desc: När hennes on-air-partner bestämmer sig för att lämna Amerikas favoritmorgonprogram, meddelar Veronika Daniels att hon kommer att välja sin nya medvärd bland en handfull kandidater som inkluderar Charlie Fisher, en lokal nyhetsuppläsare i NY.

programme.title: My Christmas Inn
programme.desc: När affärskvinnan Jennifer får reda på att hennes föräldrar tänker resa bort över julen utan henne, bestämmer hon sig för att lämna sitt hektiska storstadsliv i San Francisco för att besöka Grandma's Inn i Alaska, ett värdshus som hon har ärvt för att renovera och sedan sälja.

programme.title: Nissemannen
programme.desc: En nisse lämnas kvar av tomten för att rädda familjen Harper från en usel jul. Alven och familjen får mer än de räknade med- när barnen hjälper alven att upptäcka sina krafter- och sin sanna identitet som blivande superhjälte.

programme.title: Puppy Star Christmas
programme.desc: Pup Star-familjen har utökats! De nya valparna är: Cindy, Rosie, Charlie, och Brody, som måste lära sig julens innebörd. När Pup Stars elakingar försöker förstöra julen hamnar valparna på Nordpolen för att rädda tomten och julstämningen...

programme.title: Happy-Go-Lucky
programme.desc: Teacher Poppy uses endless supply of optimism to get through life's dramas, & spreads joy to those around her.

programme.title: A Star-Crossed Christmas
programme.desc: Secret sparks fly between heirs of rival tree farms, risking a family feud showdown just in time for Christmas.

programme.title: A Cinderella Christmas
programme.desc: At a holiday masquerade ball, a hardworking woman falls for a bachelor while in disguise as her cousin.

programme.title: A Star-Crossed Christmas

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: En by i staten Washington våkner til det surrealistiske synet av utenlandske soldater i fallskjerm som slippes ned fra himmelen. Som et sjokk har USA blitt invadert og denne byen er det første målet. Fast bestemt på å kjempe tilbake søker en gruppe unge patrioter, under ledelse av den hjemvendte soldaten Jed (Chris Hemsworth), tilflukt i byens omkringliggende skog hvor de trener og reorganiserer seg som en geriljagruppe. Herifra slår de til mot fienden når de minst venter det.

programme.title: Bronson
programme.desc: Møt Englands voldeligste mann! I 1974 bestemte den 19 år gamle Michael Peterson seg for å bli berømt, dermed tok han med sin hjemmelagde avkuttede hagle og et hode fullt av drømmer i et forsøk på å rane et postkontor. Michael ble arrestert kort tid etter og ble i første omgang dømt til 7 års fengsel, men en serie med psykopatiske overgrep på både politi og fengselsperonale har ført til at Peterson til nå har sittet bak lås og slå i 34 år, 30 av disse i enecelle. Med en intelligent, provokativ og stilisert innfallsvinkel følger vi forvandlingen fra Michael Peterson til Storbritannias farligste fange under aliaset Charles Bronson, spilt med en forstyrrende intensitet av Tom Hardy (ROCKNROLLA, LAYER CAKE).

programme.title: Ambushed
programme.desc: Med handling satt i Los Angeles’ frenetiske undergrunn, er Agent Maxwell på poret av en internasjonal kokainsmuglingsoperasjon drevet av det kriminelle geniet Vincent Camastra.

programme.title: Arizona Raiders
programme.desc: Director William Witney helmed this smart, tense actioner, filmed on location in the Grand Canyon State.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way: Alabama
programme.desc: Kaley saves the day, Booger plays polo, and Cody and Misty do a drive-thru date on horseback.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way: Alabama

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Leland Swinnerton, 70-year-old president of a huge toy corporation, is known to everyone as Mother Goose. He goes to Charlie's Angels for assistance when someone tries to sabotage the company toys by blowing up the corporate offices, causing at least one death. Sabrina, posing as a secretary from Hong Kong, becomes friendly with Gordon Roclair, the brilliant but crazy design director. Roclair confides to Sabrina that he hates Mother Goose, and is working for Tony Phelan, a gangster with plans to gain control of the company. With Sabrina tagging along as "partner," Roclair installs secret microphones around the factory, so that Phelan can hear all the latest corporate decisions. It is a simple matter for the Angels to sabotage the saboteurs by changing the location of the microphones. Instead of picking up important conversations in Mother Goose's office, Phelan hears the secretary talking about her flowers. By planing a microphone of their own in Phelan's truck, the Angels pick up all the wire tap communications and hear the gangsters' plans. This mike is especially useful when Phelan's accomplice, Orwell, discovers the identity of Kelly, who had been working with him as a "bugging expert." Orwell forces Kelly at gunpoint to drive the truck into the country, but Bosley and Kris are right behind, listening to every word. In the end, Roclair and Phelan are completely confused. Roclair finds Mother Goose's secret plans for the new Christmas toys with Sabrina's help, but Kris switches them for a set of useless vacuum cleaner blueprints. Phelan and his hoods chase Roclair, believing he doublecrossed them. In the confusion, a booby--trapped toy cannon in the factory shoots at Roclair and he falls, only from fright, because Kris had stopped up the barrel with bubblegum. programme.title: Charlie's Angels

Also the last victim died with bits of skin under her fingernails, and Vail's arms show many scratch marks. When Denny spots Ted, he makes it appear that the jewel thief is the murderer. programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Charlie's Angels must carry out an unusual assignment: three men have stolen a sack of rubies, and when one of them, Murdoch, double-crosses his two partners by escaping with the rubies, the other two hire the Angels to recover the missing jewels. The Angels are not "hired" exactly; Sabrina is forced to put on a belt loaded with explosives, and if the rubies are not recovered within twelve hours, the belt will set off by remote control. The designer of this belt is the one who masterminded the jewel theft, a psychotic electronics wizard named Dinsmore. From the crazy look in his eye, the Angels decide they better do as he says, so Kris and Kelly go out looking for Murdoch. Since Dinsmore shot him in the back as he was running away, they check the hospital first , but after the bullet was removed, Murdoch left in a hurry in order to sell the rubies. Charlie locates two men who helped the crooks steal the gems and who may be of use, if they can be forced to talk. Kris and Kelly leave these two locked in a bathroom naked after getting the information they need, and continue their search. By some excellent acting over the phone, Sabrina makes Dinsmore think that Kris has run off with Murdoch and the rubies, so he and Sabrina head for the airport to stop them. It is part of an elaborate plan to separate Dinsmore from the belt-exploding device, and it calls for Sabrina to dive into a puddle of muddy water where the radio signal won't reach the belt. At least she hopes it doesn't! programme.desc: "Freddie the Fox" Brander is retired, but thirty years ago he was the world's greatest thief. Still dignified and charming as in days of old, he is disturbed in his retirement by two former crime partners who are sure that Freddie has the famous "Light of Arabia" diamond. They are preparing to torture him into revealing where it is, but Freddie escapes and goes straight to Charlie's Angels for help. He knows that the diamond is in the possession of oil sheik Faris Salim, who keeps it in his extremely well-guarded Caribbean estate. Freddie's plan is for the Angels to assist him in stealing the diamond once again, so that he can return it to the museum, and retire from crime forever. The Angels eagerly accept the job, and assume new identities for the Caribbean caper. Freddie and Sabrina become Lord and Lady Brander, with Bosley as their butler and Kelly as their private secretary. Kris pretends to be a racing car enthusiast in order to win the attention of Ali, Salim's mechanic-minded son. The idea is for everyone to get invited to Salim's birthday party, and once in the house, learn where the diamond is kept so Freddie can decide how to steal it. Since Salim has an affinity for nobility, invitations are not difficult to obtain. Sabrina pretends to 'faint' upon seeing the snake, and Kelly makes a wax impression of the lock to the only window in the room. This, with the secret photos, provides Freddie with all he needs to engineer the theft. A little help from Ali is needed at last minute -- he never did like his father very much. programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: The Angels have never played football before, but that changes quickly when Amy Jarvis and her father Dan come to them for help. The Jarvis' football team, all women, has a big game scheduled against Julia Smyth's Panthers, but a pair of motorcycle riders has been terrorizing Amy and warning her not to play. Joining the team is only a cover, but Sabrina displays such good form that Julia Smyth invites her to play for the Panthers. Julia's only concern is winning, and her players are rough and well trained. More interestingly to Sabrina, Julia rides a motorcycle. But whether or not the Angels solve the mystery, Sabrina is so disgusted by Julia's "win-at-any-cost" attitude that she is determined to help Amy's team defeat the Panthers. Kelly meets a sad person named Joe Phillips in the parking lot, and they go out for dinner. Joe is a former football star whose injured knee forced him to retire, and now he feels like only half a man. Joe does not seem involved with the recent trouble, and Kelly grows tired of hearing how sad his life is. By locating all the local dealers who sell a certain kind of motorcycle, the Angels find the two that were used to scare the players, and driving away in a truck is none other than Joe Phillips. Furthermore he has taken blueprints of the stadium with him, as though he needed to know how to gain entry into rooms that would be locked, like the room where the stadium's safe is kept. Down on the field, Sabrina realizes that one of her teammates is Julia's spy and is secretly telling the Panthers what plays to expect. Using this knowledge, Sabrina outsmarts the cheaters, by calling one play and then running a different one. Catching crooks is the Angels' job, but winning this game is very satisfying. programme.title: Drop Dead Diva
programme.desc: Upon returning to work following Gina Blunt's arrest, Jane and Grayson are representing Kathy Kelton, who is suing her late fiancé Scott Richards' stepmother Caitlin over custody of his cremated remains. Though the case looks weak after Scott's sister testifies that Kathy is eating her fiancé's ashes, a sympathetic Grayson presses Jane to continue. Meanwhile, when Parker reveals that he secretly allowed the FBI to use the firm to nab Gina, Kim is angry over being kept in the dark about the sting. And as Jane starts to accept that Owen's sudden disappearance means that he's left her for another woman, she's surprised when he suddenly returns. When Kathy says that eating his ashes allows her to see Scott's ghost, Jane wonders if she would be better off getting psychological rather than legal help. But after Kathy collapses in the courtroom, she's found to be suffering from heavy metal poisoning. After tests indicate that Kathy was poisoned by a deadly chemical she ingested by eating Scott's remains, Grayson suspects that Caitlin used the substance to murder her stepson in order to inherit the $20 million he was about to receive from his father's estate. When he finally convinces Jane to listen to what he has to say, Owen explains his disappearance by revealing that he was getting checked out at the Mayo Clinic when he had a heart attack that left him in a coma for weeks. But while Jane wants to pick up where they left off, concerns about his health cause Owen to withdraw his marriage proposal. After Teri is declared the winner of a song contest, she asks Luke for a loan to finance a recording. When he looks into the record company, however, Luke discovers that Teri is the target of a con man. And when Luke takes her to a performance given by another of the contest winners, Teri learns the truth about the con. Finally, though Caitlin has already disposed of Scott's ashes, Jane tricks her into revealing what she did by claiming that Kathy kept some of the remains

programme.title: Drop Dead Diva
programme.desc: As Jane tries to avoid aggravating Owen's heart condition, Deb's mother Bobbie Dobkins is being sued for an injury sustained by her dance student, Kiera Walsh. As she's meeting with Kiera's mom Megan, Jane is unhappy to learn that Bobbie's insurance company has assigned the pushy and annoying lawyer Simon Grundy to represent its interests. Meanwhile, Grayson's high school classmate Fiona Krupp hires him when the city of Lakewood refuses to pay her for a sculpture it commissioned and now claims is obscene. And when Luke seeks her advice about buying concert tickets for a date, Stacy assumes they are for her. Once Kiera testifies that Bobbie made her do a dance move that resulted in what Megan says is a career-ending injury, both Jane and Simon ask Bobbie to consider settling. While Jane gets Megan to consider payment for Kiera's medical costs, Simon insists that she also withdraw the claim for loss of future earnings. So when Bobbie makes matters worse by saying that Kiera would have never made it as a professional dancer, Megan angrily refuses any offer. And when she vindictively amends the lawsuit to include emotional distress, Bobbie looks to strengthen her legal team by firing Jane and hiring Parker. Meanwhile, Grayson proves that Lakewood officials approved Fiona's sketches, and Judge Owen French orders the city to pay her for the finished piece. Although Megan settles with the insurance company for Kiera's medical bills, Bobbie still remains liable for the emotional damage claim. But when Jane finds that Kiera was actually injured while skateboarding before her dance lesson, not only does the jury decide in Bobbie's favor, but the insurance company fires Simon. When Teri organizes a demonstration in support of Fiona's artwork, Owen is inspired to rule that it cannot be altered by the city. And after Fiona admits that she always intended her sculpture to be provocative in order to gain notoriety for her work, she and Grayson start a romantic relationship.

programme.title: Drop Dead Diva
programme.desc: With the support of Councilman Mark Phillips, Jane files a lawsuit on behalf of Jenny Evans, a teenager who collapsed at a rave put on by promoter Dennis Fullman. After she receives a death threat against Owen meant to dissuade her from pursuing the case, Jane opts not to tell him for fear of aggravating his heart condition. However, once Owen learns that he's under police protection and insists Jane continue with the suit, things get tougher when Jenny's friend Carla admits that they took ecstasy before the rave. Meanwhile, when Owen hesitates to invite his father to their wedding, Jane asks Stacy to investigate. After donating his sperm to Carrie Renner, Dan Abraham hires Kim and Grayson when Carrie and her new fiancé Rick Keller insist that he relinquish his parental rights. Though Keller has Dan arrested for illegally trafficking in human tissue, the case is dropped after Kim demands that anyone who engaged in a privately arranged sperm donation also be prosecuted. And when Keller accuses Dan of violating a state law that prohibits gay men from being sperm donors, Kim's contention that the government has no business dictating how people choose to get pregnant prompts Carrie to leave her bullying fiancé and negotiate visitation rights for Dan. When Jenny dies, both her mother and Carla insist that Jane pursue her case. After an autopsy shows that Jenny died from dehydration and not a drug overdose, Jane and Owen discover that the water fountains in the Coliseum were turned off, leaving the 30,000 attendees to buy bottled water from a company owned by none other than Councilman Phillips. And once Jane finds proof that he's behind the threat against Owen, Phillips is arrested for Jenny's death. Finally, Owen admits that his reluctance over the invitation stems from his disapproval of his father's recent wedding. But as Owen reconciles with his dad, Jane resists telling him the truth about her identity.

programme.title: Drop Dead Diva
programme.desc: Alleging that Vanden Pharmaceuticals' antidepressant Aprox caused his client Sheila Reese to miscarry, celebrity trial lawyer Lawrence Brand arranges for Jane to help in his lawsuit. When Brand shows up late for the first day of the trial, Jane is on her own after Vanden's lawyers reveal that Sheila had been taking a dangerous painkiller while she was pregnant. And after she can't find documents that Brand claims are in the case file, Jane worries about his mental state when he becomes disoriented during his courtroom presentation. Meanwhile, Jane hesitates to tell Stacy that she'll be moving out once she and Owen find a house. Enlisting Grayson's help when Jonah Pierce claims he owns the patent on the pake, Stacy realizes that the one person who can back up her story is her ex-business partner and con artist Nikki LePree. Finding her in jail under another name, Grayson offers to keep Nikki's identity a secret in exchange for photos that prove Stacy invented the pake. But when they fail to convince the judge, Stacy and Grayson challenge Jonah to a bake-off to establish who's telling the truth. Meanwhile, when Luke decides to advance his relationship with Kim, he's surprised when she suddenly claims that she doesn't want to see him anymore. Tracking down Brand's ex-wife, Jane learns that he has a degenerative brain condition known as Pick's disease. When confronted with the truth, Brand agrees to let Jane take the lead in the lawsuit, but not before falsely claiming he has proof that Vanden knew about the dangers of Aprox. So with Owen's encouragement, Jane makes it appear as though she actually has the study's results, forcing a Vanden executive to freeze up on the witness stand. And when the company agrees to settle, Brand credits Jane for salvaging the case before announcing that he is retiring. programme.title: The Sidwell’s: Steve and Krysy Sidwell on Marriage, Teenage Tear-Ups and Book Club Blunders
programme.desc: On today’s episode of The Therapy Crouch, Abbey and Peter are joined by some of their oldest and closest friends - Steve and Krysy Sidwell. In a friendship spanning two decades which has seen the couples share career paths, holidays and some outrageous nights out, this podcast is full of laughs and a behind the curtain, sneak peak into what it’s like being best friends with your favourite pair of podcasters! Steve and Krysy discuss what they think has made their 20 year marriage stay rock solid after all these years and how they are navigating having three teenage boys who have developed of penchant for knocking seven bells of sh*t out of each other on a regular basis. In the Agony Ab section, we hear from a listener who has some concerns about his wife’s recent fashion choices as well what to do in the awkward situation when someone likes you more than you like them - so stay tuned for that!! Enjoy this week’s Therapy Crouch!

programme.title: The Therapy Crouch - Will You Marry Me?

programme.title: They Call Me The Godfather
programme.desc: Welcome back to The Therapy Crouch! On this week’s episode Abbey and Peter are on hand to share some pearls of wisdom on what makes a good godparent, and some top tips on how to expertly navigate a thanks but no thanks conversation with your nearest and dearest. In Agony Ab, Abbey and Peter are on hand to help when your better half suddenly decides to take up the gym 10 years too late and we hear from Louis, one of our international listeners who needs some advice on how to make the first move! We hope you enjoy this very special episode from the OG Podfather and your fairy Podmother!

programme.title: Jimmy Carr on Feminism, Parenting, and Success
programme.desc: Comedian Jimmy Carr discusses defining success without comparing yourself to others, the importance of hard work, and why he doesn't fear cancel culture. He explains his views on feminism and motherhood, why he refuses to use the term "babysitting" for parenting his own children, and how his anxieties fuel his comedy.

programme.title: Nafessa Williams On Racism, Sexism, and Rivals
programme.desc: Rivals actress Nafessa Williams discusses playing the only black woman in a white man's world in 1980s Britain, and how she sees her acting as her contribution to activism and representation. She explores what it means to be on a TV show with intimate scenes, the journey from law to acting, manifestation and taking action, faith and optimism, and the importance of rest alongside ambition.

programme.title: Carol Vorderman Talks Politics, Education, and Parenting
programme.desc: Broadcaster Carol Vorderman discusses her early life, from her family running away with the circus and living out of a car, to being one of the first girls to read engineering at Cambridge University. She reveals who wrote her first application to Countdown and explains why everything about our lives is political, from the pressure put on kids and parents by schools to women's bodily autonomy.

programme.title: Poorna Bell On How To Put Yourself First
programme.desc: Award-winning journalist and author Poorna Bell joins Fearne to talk about ageing, ambition, marriage, motherhood, grief and the quiet rage that can build when women feel invisible. From challenging the narrative that women "disappear" in midlife, to questioning the myth of "having it all", this conversation is about reclaiming agency, on your own terms.

programme.title: Liz Earle On Her Perimenopause And Midlife Reinvention
programme.desc: Broadcaster and healthy ageing expert Liz Earle discusses her transformation from overwhelmed, overweight, and exhausted during perimenopause to thriving in her 60s. She shares the lifestyle shifts that improved her health, including the importance of morning light and circadian rhythms, strength training, sleep, and consistency in wellbeing.

programme.title: Ruby Wax On Why Trump Scares Her!
programme.desc: Have you noticed that your memory and rational thinking disappear when you're anxious? Ruby Wax wants you to retrain your focus and attention in a digital world that's always trying to steal it. In this chat with Fearne – live from the Happy Place Festival – Ruby explains the difference between mental health and mental illness, and why she calls meditation 'mind gym'.

programme.title: Dr Julie on Triggers And Behaviour Patterns
programme.desc: Psychologist Dr Julie Smith discusses why criticism hurts so deeply, explaining how your brain needs evidence rather than mantras to build self-worth and change your critical inner voice. She explores why feedback from others can trigger old wounds and how patterns developed in childhood keep replaying in adulthood.

programme.title: Everything Louis Theroux Got Wrong About The Manosphere
programme.desc: Last week, Netflix dropped Louis Theroux's exploration of the manosphere. But, some watchers of the patriarchal online world were left unimpressed. James Bloodworth, who embedded himself in the manosphere for his book Lost Boys, was "underwhelmed".

programme.title: Every Generation Tries Each Other's Alcoholic Drinks
programme.desc: Representatives from different generations go head-to-head by trying the drinks that supposedly define each one. From Millennials to Boomers, everyone gets the chance to sample another generation's favourite tipple. The group tests Buzzballz, dark fruit cider, gin and tonic, rum and white wine, and bitter beer.

programme.title: Chris Hemsworth, Halle Berry & Mark Ruffalo Take On The British Test
programme.desc: Chris Hemsworth, Halle Berry and Mark Ruffalo take on the British Test. From making the perfect cup of tea to trying classic British snacks like sausage rolls, the results are hilarious. They see if they know which way the British public voted from Marvel vs DC to who they'd prefer to do a heist with. They put their British knowledge and taste buds to the test.

programme.title: Catherine Connolly On Palestine And A United Ireland
programme.desc: We speak with Irish presidential candidate Catherine Connolly. We look at the shape of Ireland, the involvement of younger people in politics, the Occupied Territories Bill, Irish neutrality and the triple lock. Catherine also speaks about the importance of the Irish language and why it's important to have women in politics and in the public eye.

programme.title: Brian Kerr On Beating Portugal And Ireland's Underage Triumphs
programme.desc: Brian Kerr reflects on his biggest successes with St Patrick's Athletic in the League of Ireland, his time in charge of Ireland's underage teams and beating Portugal and Netherlands as Ireland senior football manager.

programme.title: Brian Cox’s Guide To Being A True Scot
programme.desc: Brian Cox sets the record straight on what it really means to be Scottish. From authentic Scottish slang to the biggest misconceptions people, especially in America, still get wrong. With sharp wit and no-nonsense honesty, he dives into real Scottish slang and what it actually means, the stereotypes that need binning immediately, the cultural differences that confuse the rest of the world, and a cheeky look at some of America's more baffling takes on Scotland.

programme.title: Big Tech Is Destroying Democracy - Beeban Kidron Interview
programme.desc: Baroness Beeban Kidron, filmmaker and tech campaigner, discusses her book Users: How Big Tech Took Control and How to Fight Back. She breaks down how big tech companies have influenced democracy, warped regulatory structures for their own benefit, and knowingly harmed their users.

programme.title: When Did Elon Musk Lose His Mind?
programme.desc: When did Elon Musk make the jump from salesman to supervillain? Quinn Slobodian and Ben Tarnoff trace Musk's journey from tech billionaire to stalwart of the online right. From his upbringing in apartheid South Africa to the rise of Tesla and SpaceX, they detail his changing views on AI and the "woke mind virus", as well as his eventual alliance with Donald Trump. Slobodian and Tarnoff examine his industrial philosophy, what led him to the White House, his purchase of Twitter, and his various attempts to further fuse technology into our lives.

programme.title: We Quiz FLO On Their Own Songs
programme.desc: FLO go head-to-head in the ultimate JOE Pub Quiz. The girls put their music knowledge to the test in a rapid-fire battle featuring rounds including Guess the Legendary Song from the First 5 Seconds, Do They Know Their Own Song Lyrics and a test of their general music knowledge. Along the way, FLO take on Zara Larsson's iconic Lush Life dance, chat Ariana Grande, Rihanna and more, and things get seriously competitive as they battle it out to become the one and only JOE Pub Quiz champion.

programme.title: Tom Holland vs Zendaya vs Jacob - Spider Man Quiz Showdown
programme.desc: Tom Holland, Zendaya and Jacob Batalon go head-to-head in the ultimate Spider-Man pub quiz. These legends put their memories to the test in a rapid-fire quiz covering their Spider-Man films. Do they know their lines, know about the franchise and even know random stills from the films? With bragging rights on the line and the title of pub quiz champion up for grabs, things quickly descend into chaos, confusion and comedy.

programme.title: Old People Try Bizarre Food
programme.desc: The Old People are back, this time taking on some of the internet's most bizarre celebrity food combinations. From viral TikTok trends to A-list guilty pleasures, they try and rate Dua Lipa's Pickle Diet Coke, Channing Tatum's Peanut Butter, Jelly & Cheetos Sandwich, and Beyoncé's Banana with Ketchup. Will these celebrity creations be surprisingly delicious or completely disgusting. Our Old People give their brutally honest verdicts.

programme.title: Keir Starmer’s Weirdest Moments As Prime Minister
programme.desc: Keir Starmer's time in office has come to a close. His legacy includes some strange moments. From meeps to releasing sausages to going footy mad, relive all of the best and worst moments from the last two years. Hear clashes with Rishi Sunak and Kemi Badenoch, awkward encounters with Donald Trump, and gaffes at various major summits.

programme.title: AI CEOs Being Absolutely Insane
programme.desc: Have you ever paid attention to the voices behind the 'inevitable' AI revolution? OpenAI's Sam Altman, SpaceX's Elon Musk, and Palantir's Alex Karp are among the tech elite. They're building the models they claim will change work, politics, and life forever. But when they talk about this future, their rhetoric ranges from bizarre to sinister. From Musk's prediction that there's "a 10 to 20% chance of killer robots wiping out humanity" to Altman's sale of intelligence as utility, things look pretty bleak.

programme.title: Donald Trump’s Most Embarrassing Moments
programme.desc: Donald Trump has a lot to say about the world. That doesn't mean he knows what he's talking about. From China to Venezuela and Canada to the UK, watch Trump's questionable comments about all corners of the globe.

programme.title: Gary Stevenson Interview
programme.desc: Gary Stevenson, economist and ex-Citibank trader, returns to PoliticsJOE just days after Andy Burnham became Prime Minister. Stevenson explains why he expects Labour to dodge serious taxation of the ultra-wealthy, instead quietly shifting the burden onto the upper middle class through moves like equalising capital gains and income tax. He breaks down why cutting VAT on energy bills is a quick political win rather than a real fix, and why he believes every government that fails to tax extreme wealth eventually gets forced into austerity, creating fertile ground for Reform and Farage.

programme.title: Generational - Football Debate
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Generational, a series bringing together football fans from every generation to debate the biggest talking points in the game. Topics include whether the Premier League has ruined football, if players from the 60s and 70s could cope in today's game, whether Jack Grealish is better than Pelé, if the FA Cup is still a major trophy, and whether Manchester City should be stripped of their trophies if found guilty. Different generations bring different perspectives, experiences and opinions, with plenty of disagreement and passionate arguments throughout.

programme.title: On The Ground at CPAC GB
programme.desc: Why are transatlantic forces of the right assembling in North Greenwich? Andy Twelves investigates CPAC GB, the new offshoot of America's longstanding Conservative Political Action Conference that hopes to unite the right in the UK. Attendees range from Tories like Liz Truss and Jacob Rees-Mogg to online voices like Young Bob and nationalist influencer Angloid to Americans who have made the trip across the pond. Nigel Farage attended the second day of the conference, and other speakers included Matt Goodwin and Matt Schlapp, CPAC's chair. Watch various factions of the right, from Conservatives to the Reform and Restore curious, fight for their ideas in speaking halls and a dimly lit expo centre.

programme.title: JOE Pub Quiz with TommyInnit and Max Fosh
programme.desc: TommyInnit and Max Fosh go head-to-head in the Joe Pub Quiz with a YouTube twist, battling it out across rounds testing their knowledge of the platform, iconic YouTube moments and some of the biggest names in internet history. From guessing who said which iconic line, to throwback YouTube apologies from Logan Paul, classic Sidemen diss tracks and a final rapid-fire round where they have to identify famous YouTubers from photos. Along the way, Tommy and Max also get into some of the biggest debates in YouTube history, including whether we need to bring proper YouTube apologies back, the golden era of diss tracks and what KSI leaving the Sidemen means for them.

programme.title: Faroe Islands - A Secret Beauty
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Apes and Aliens
programme.desc: The Congo, mighty and deep like no other river - yet still a retreat and a habitat for several of our world's strangest animals. Our closest relatives live deep inside the dense jungles: three of the four giant ape species have made the Congo basin their home. Rich in extraordinary footage, the second episode of "Myths of the Congo" also presents exciting insights into one of the most mysterious and dangerous regions on earth.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Deep and Dangerous
programme.desc: The river that swallows all rivers - this is what the natives call it. In reality, the Congo, when considering its water masses, is the second largest and the deepest river in the world. At its source in the north of Zambia, it starts out as a mere trickle, but on its journey westwards it grows and grows, becoming ever mightier and with it, the animals, too: the shoebill stork hides in the dense papyrus. Metre-long pythons hunt for their prey in trees and huge hippos fight for power and respect in the water. To survive in the Congo, animals have to adapt to extreme conditions. Here, evolution has spawned unique creatures: fish with lungs, wings and those that go hunting on land. The Congo River feeds the second largest rainforest on earth. Here is the home of the forest elephant. Time and again, they are summoned to this one, magic place: the Dzanga Bay. Countless other forest dwellers join them. What makes this place so special?

programme.title: Wild Switzerland
programme.desc: Gentle, green meadows, rugged rock faces, mysterious lakes, dense forests, tall mountains, low-lying river deltas, quietly meandering mountain streams and smack dab in the middle, a unique fauna - THIS is Switzerland! We trace the elementary power of nature and present animals and plants in landscapes that have hardly ever been touched by mankind. Switzerland is an alpine country, but it is also Europe's surge tank. Rivers such as the Rhine and the Rhone have their sources here. Glaciers, crevasses, icy cold caves and the underwater dome of the Verzasca are the unusual settings we chose for this film. We meet with rare, selected animal species and present their behavioural patterns, such as the Swiss or Arven jay, the lynx and albino catfish. Cold, wind, snow and extreme locations demand adaptation that make us marvel.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: North Macedonia: Between Traditional Dances and Mini Navy
programme.desc: Northern Macedonia emerged from being a once constituent republic of the former Yugoslavia. Anyone wishing to discover unknown worlds has every chance of finding them in this young Balkan country, full of imposing mountains, lakes of crystal-clear water, original villages and centuries-old customs. Nevertheless, Northern Macedonia, which borders Serbia in the north and Greece in the south, considered to be one of the poorest countries in Europe.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.desc: Its native fragrant flowers and aromatic herbs have made the Provence a brand known worldwide. The wealth of flora found in this region, between the French Alps and the Mediterranean, is unequalled among the French provinces. Around Sault, near Mont Ventoux, the valleys and high plains are carpeted with bright violet: In the hot climate of the South of France, lavender blooms and exudes its fragrance. Monastic healers have been using its aromatic medicinal oil since the Middle Ages. And today an entire industry is based on the trade with this fragrant flower. Yet the livelihood of Provençal lavender farmers is imperiled. In France’s major lavender-growing region, the “Plateau de Valensole”, our viewers encounter Gérard Blanc, who has been hit particularly hard. The lavender farmer lost sixty percent of his harvest to one tiny insect: the leafhopper. This insect has already destroyed half of the lavender acreage, bumping France from its market position as the world’s top producer of lavender oil. The film visits a resolute farmer who, not about to give up, is testing methods to fend off the voracious insect.

programme.title: I'M LIVE - sogumm episode 233
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is sogumm famous for her unique voice and heartfelt music! This artist made herself known to the public through one TV competition show in 2019. Thanks to her wide musical spectrum and outstanding producing skills she won the competition and soon joined the record label AOMG. Of course she continued to pleasantly surprised listeners under the label. Her first album Sobrightttttttt earned both critical and commercial success and that success led her to win the coveted Rookie Prize at the 17th Korean Music Awards. She has also collaborated with a numner of A-list artists including ZICO Oh Hyuk 10CM DJ Wegun and Hoody and her ever-evolving artistry definitely makes us anticipate her future as a musician. In October this year sogumm released her full-length album Precious securing her unique spot in the industry. In this episode sogumm performs Insecurity Prescription Precious and more to show off the essence of her artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented musician!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - nokdu episode 234
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is risking city-pop songwriter nokdu! nokdu made his big debut in 2018 with the single Say My Name. As a graduate of The Liverpool Institute for Performing Arts founded by Paul McCartney and Mark Featherstone-Witty he covers a wide range of genres in his music ranging from Brit-pop to punk to R&B. Backed up by his academic background he boasts his outstanding ability not only as a songwriter but also a lyricist producer and singer. Also known for his stage manners he is quickly capturing the ears and souls of countless listeners. Currently he's taking part in the competition program Super Band 2. His fantastic performance in the show definitely makes us anticipate his future as a musician. In this episode nokdu performs Stay With Me Wona and more to show off the essence of his artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - WeAreYoung episode 235
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the sensual pop-duo WeAreYoung! Composed of keyboardist and vocalist KIM Kyung-min and guitarist and vocalist GU Ki-hoon this duo made themselves known to the public with their heartfelt songs about youth and love. Thanks to their outstanding musicality they won the 2017 Shinhan Card Rookie Award the Silver Prize at the 2017 Martin Contest and Best Rookie at the Beautiful Mint Life 2018. This year they were chosen as recipients of the MUSE ON 2021 which aims to connect musicians and fans during the COVID-19 pandemic. Earlier this year WeAreYoung announced their much-anticipated comeback after completing their mandatory military duties and they are bound to impress once again with their songs A Day Full Of You Let's not do that Only I Love You and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these two talented musicians!

The Rescue Crew decide to reveal their creator’s identity, but little do they know that the mysterious Dr. Zinc is already collaborating with Limo and Franklin on the lunar mission. With all the experts too busy to upload the new firmware, Ryan decides to take matters into his own hands. Meanwhile, Boss Karr and Valerie encounter Eugene’s latest invention – an android lookalike – and Boss Karr hatches a plot to infiltrate the moon program.

Franklin and Limo get to work, and the boys explore their new base of operations. After hearing an inspiring anecdote from the project director, Ryan decides to start beta-testing the updated Tritanware. Meanwhile, Boss Karr and Valerie attack downtown Daedo City, hoping to distract the Tobots from their presence at Whitesail HQ, and it’s up to Kaylee, Chuck, and Ben to stop them. M, P, and L arrive on the scene, but Boss Karr’s latest battle bot has a secret weapon that prevents them from forming Rescue 3.

programme.title: Mortdecai
programme.desc: Charlie Mortdecai är en charmerande konstkännare och livsnjutare med dyra vanor. Han går med på att hjälpa den brittiska underrättelsetjänsten MI5 med att hitta en stulen tavla som sägs gömma på koden till en svindlande summa gömda nazimiljoner...

programme.title: Jenny's Wedding
programme.desc: Jenny Farrell ska gifta sig. Men hur ska hennes pryda föräldrar reagera när de får veta att kvinnan som de trodde var deras dotters rumskompis egentligen är hennes fästmö?

programme.title: Jag, Daniel Blake (I, Daniel Blake)
programme.desc: 'Jag, Daniel Blake' handlar om den 59-årige snickaren Daniel (Dave Johns) som på grund av sjukdom blivit arbetslös. Enligt hans läkare bör han inte jobba under en längre period, men enligt myndigheterna är han för frisk för att vara sjukskriven.

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: Chris Wilton är en ung, vacker men pank tennistränare som blir involverad i en rik familj genom att träna en av familjemedlemmarna. Kärleksaffärer med två kvinnor samtidigt tvingar honom att begå ett allvarligt brott. Passion, frestelse och besatthet i överklassens London.
